overview: Global (2026) roadmap for engineers who build products, not just features. Focuses on the intersection of fullstack technical mastery, product-led growth (PLG) strategy, AI-native workflows, and observability.

steps.title: Product Mindset & Growth Engineering
steps.description: Understanding the business logic and user psychology that justifies why a feature exists.
subtopics: North Star Metrics: Identifying the single signal that defines product success
Conversion Funnels: Mastering Acquisition → Activation → Retention → Referral → Revenue
Unit Economics: Understanding LTV (Lifetime Value) vs. CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
Time to First Value (TTV): Engineering 'Aha!' moments within the first 60 seconds
Prioritization Frameworks: RICE scoring (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort)
Experimentation: Designing A/B tests and 'Synthetic Evals' for feature validation

steps.title: Modern Product Architecture
steps.description: Building modular, event-driven systems that can pivot as fast as the market.
subtopics: Domain-Driven Design (DDD): Aligning code structure with business domains
Event-Driven Architecture (EDA): Using real-time triggers for sync and personalization
Modular Monoliths vs. Microservices: Choosing the right scale for the product stage
API Design & Documentation: GraphQL, REST, and 'API-First' thinking
Feature Flagging: Decoupling deployment from release using PostHog or LaunchDarkly
Database Patterns: Relational for consistency vs. Document for rapid iteration

steps.title: AI-Native Engineering Workflows
steps.description: Integrating AI as a core architectural layer and a development accelerator.
subtopics: Context Engineering: Building persistent AI workspaces that remember persona constraints
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Connecting LLMs to live product data
AI Agentic Workflows: Creating autonomous systems that plan and use tools
Evaluation Frameworks: Measuring accuracy to prevent model hallucinations
Vibe Coding: Rapidly iterating on functional prototypes using tools like Cursor or v0
AI UI Patterns: Streaming responses, skeleton loaders, and human-in-the-loop triggers

steps.title: Observability & Operational Effectiveness
steps.description: Monitoring the health of the product through the lens of the user experience.
subtopics: Cycle Time: Measuring the duration from 'Idea' to 'Production'
Defect Rate: Monitoring bug frequency early in the sprint cycle
User Error Monitoring: Catching frontend crashes using Sentry or LogRocket
Product Analytics: Tracking events and heatmaps with Amplitude or Mixpanel
Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR): Optimizing the speed of critical system fixes
Deployment Strategies: Blue/Green, Canary releases, and graceful rollbacks

steps.title: Design for Engineers & UX Empathy
steps.description: Building polished, accessible interfaces without needing a dedicated designer for every change.
subtopics: Design Systems: Building/consuming Tailwind CSS or Headless UI components
8pt Grid System & Visual Hierarchy basics
Micro-interactions: Using Framer Motion for high-quality 'feel'
Accessibility (A11y): Screen reader compatibility and keyboard navigation
Responsive Design: Fluid layouts across mobile, desktop, and foldables

steps.title: Capstone Projects: Product Engineer Showcase
steps.description: Projects that demonstrate 'Mini-CTO' thinking—balancing tech, product, and AI.

projects.name: AI-Powered CRM with Autonomous Outreach
projects.description: A CRM that uses RAG to understand customer history and AI Agents to draft personalized emails based on live triggers.
showcase_tips: Include a 'Product Spec' explaining the RICE score of the agent feature
Show A/B test results of different email templates
Demonstrate observability dashboards for agent success rates

projects.name: Collaborative Real-time Incident Command Center
projects.description: A dashboard for dev teams to manage outages. Features real-time sync, incident timelines, and AI-generated post-mortems.
showcase_tips: Show conflict resolution in the collaborative editor
Include a demo of the AI summarizing the incident log

projects.name: Smart E-Learning Platform with Adaptive Curriculum
projects.description: Uses AI to re-order course modules based on quiz performance and user speed (TTV focus).
showcase_tips: Expose the 'User Journey Map' in the README
Show the vector search logic for content recommendations
